name: Compromised endpoint and EDR isolation
description: PC-2 is compromised. EDR, IDS-1 and IPS-1 react; the SOC operator isolates it and the other endpoints keep working.

endpoint_events.reason: Simulated beaconing and credential-dumping behaviour (synthetic EDR telemetry)

presentation.objective: Show the SOC workflow: detect a compromised endpoint, investigate, contain it, and show that others are unaffected.
presentation.security_rule: EDR state machine, IDS D1 (port scan), IPS-1 policy for D1, and the EDR isolation policy (the isolated endpoint's network traffic is blocked).
presentation.explanation: At 1 s the EDR agent on PC-2 reports a compromise to EDR-MGMT-1 and the SIEM opens an incident. From 3 s PC-2 scans APP-SRV: IDS-1 (passive) and IPS-1 (inline) both detect it. At 9 s the operator isolates PC-2 (Isolate Endpoint in its panel, or scripted in the automated run). After that PC-2's traffic is dropped at its own agent, while PC-1 still reaches APP-SRV.
expected: EDR alert for PC-2 at 1 s and PC-2 shown as compromised
IDS-1 and IPS-1 detect the scan from PC-2 (D1)
After isolation PC-2's packets are dropped with reason edr_isolated
PC-1's session after the isolation is delivered
One SIEM incident connects the EDR, IDS, IPS and isolation events
